notes: CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE NOTE: REFERENCE GEOMETRY - SolidWorks 2D Sketches require a PLANAR surface (Flat Face or Plane). A Base Feature can produce curved surfaces (e.g., shaft face). For cuts on curved faces, create a 'Reference Plane' (tangent) before cutting. Typical flow: 1) Create base (cylinder). 2) Create reference plane (tangent to cylinder). 3) Cut/keyway on reference plane. Omitting this can cause SelectPlanarFace errors when the API expects a planar face.

base_features.name: Sheet Metal Base Flange
base_features.description: Creates the initial sheet metal body.

reference_features.name: Reference Plane
reference_features.description: Creates a construction plane for sketching on curved surfaces or at angles.

reference_features.name: Reference Axis
reference_features.description: Creates a construction line (centerline) for patterns or revolves.
